items.title: 3 U.S. Homebuilder Stocks Facing Margin Pressure As New Home Sales Jump
items.summary: U.S. homebuilding just threw investors a curveball. New single-family sales jumped 14.2% in October to a 10‑month high, even as mortgage rates hover around 7.28% and builders lean on discounts that can squeeze profit margins. That mix of firm demand, price cuts and softer permit activity is creating potential openings and risks.
